mapper.sql: select account_id, member_id, total_points, available_points, used_points, expired_points, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from iip_points_account
mapper.insert: insert into iip_points_account ( member_id, total_points, available_points, used_points, expired_points, version, create_by, remark, create_time )values( #{memberId}, #{totalPoints}, #{availablePoints}, #{usedPoints}, #{expiredPoints}, #{version}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update iip_points_account set available_points = available_points + #{points}, total_points = total_points + #{points}, update_time = sysdate() where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select:
select a.account_id, a.member_id, a.total_points, a.available_points, a.used_points, a.expired_points, a.version, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, m.nickname from iip_points_account a left join iip_member m on m.member_id = a.member_id
AND a.member_id = #{memberId}
AND m.nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%')
order by a.account_id asc
